acceptanceCriteria: go-product-static (or an equivalent required job) runs the same cross-vet GOOS set as make cross-vet.
Reintroducing an unconstrained syscall.Mkfifo in a _test.go file fails a required hosted check.
The change is a .github/ change merged under decision 0390 (owner posts ci-control-plane success).
body: Filed 2026-09-26. The v0-6 full gate at ff3b58c failed in make cross-vet: internal/tasks/archive and internal/tasks/journal stage_read_test.go called syscall.Mkfifo without a build constraint (fixed in PR #257). Hosted CI only runs GOOS=windows go build ./... (.github/workflows/ci.yml:140 and :169), which does not compile _test.go files, so the break merged and was found only by the local gate hours later. Add GOOS=windows (and darwin from linux) go vet ./... to go-product-static.
title: Hosted CI does not vet test files for Windows, so cross-OS test compile breaks reach main
